perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: No materially newer source displaced the current evidence: raised 2026 EBITDA/DCF guidance and CCL Stage 3 completion remain the strongest reusable signals.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Higher guidance and train completion support execution, while expansion economics remain contingent on construction discipline, approvals, contracts/spreads and feedgas availability.

contradictions: GAAP net-loss volatility coexists with strong adjusted EBITDA, requiring careful separation of derivatives/accounting from operating economics.
